measurement.method: scripts/analyze-ui.py + scripts/measure-accent2.py + custom row/column BMP scans (measurement-only, on top of the vision analysis)
measurement.visionDominantBackground: #ffffff at 90% share (cards + canvas read near-white on the crop; the cool gray canvas is #f6f8fb per vision, between-card gutters)
measurement.accentBlueModal: #066fd1 (14936 px, p25=p50=p75 — flat solid fills: buttons, charts, active nav)
measurement.borderLineRows: y=204/242/465/627/717/734 — 1px gray lines #e6e7e9..#eceef0, runs up to 630px (card top/bottom edges)
measurement.cornerProfile: top-left card corner insets x by 0,2,5px over 3 rows — small arc, consistent with 4px (vision estimated 4-8px)
measurement.divergenceFromParentEstimate: parent estimated accent #1677d2; pixel modal is #066fd1 (same hue family ~210). The pixel-exact value wins per the absolute own-analysis rule.

frame.notes: The reference page has NO outer frame: white cards sit directly on a cool-gray canvas (#f6f8fb). In eDEX terms the bar/panel CELLS are the canvas — no borders, no glow on them; all card treatment lives on the widget sections. Reference uses flat light gray hairlines, never glowing neon.

cards.notes: Every widget is a closed white rectangle: 1px solid #e6e7e9 border, 4px radius, flat white fill, at most a barely-there drop shadow (no glow, no gradient, no brackets). Cards float on the canvas with ~16px gaps.

dividers.notes: Hairline separators under card headers and between list rows (measured 1px #e6e7e9 rows at y=204/242).

inputs.notes: Form-field border is one step darker than the card border (gray-300 family); not directly measurable in the viewport — derived from the border gray family and Tabler's field styling. Focus ring is a soft blue halo (accent-tinted).

activeIndicators.notes: Active nav item carries a thin 2px blue underline under its label (top nav); selected/active surfaces take a pale blue tint (#ebf3fb). No left accent bars.

themeImplementationNotes.shellMapping: --edex-bg/--edex-panel = canvas #f6f8fb; --edex-panel-2 = card white #ffffff; --edex-border = #e6e7e9; --edex-green = #066fd1 (accent token name kept, value is the blue accent); --edex-amber = #d63939; --edex-red = #d63939; --edex-cyan = #066fd1
themeImplementationNotes.workspaceTokens: --dsw-alias-bg-base/-layer-1/-layer-2/-overlay, --dsw-specific-sidebar-fill, --dsw-specific-input-major = #ffffff (card surface) so the DSH workspace reads as the same white surface as the cards
themeImplementationNotes.granularity: per-card treatment (1px #e6e7e9 full rectangle, 4px radius, white fill, subtle shadow) on WidgetSection boxes ONLY; panel cells stay bare canvas; center slot WidgetSection stays transparent; center CONTAINER (.centerWidget) carries the same card chrome + white title strip with hairline divider and dark uppercase title
themeImplementationNotes.fonts: light enterprise sans stack; eDEX monospace flourishes dropped in favor of the reference's Inter-like sans for titles/values
